description: Human-reviewed Phase 1A taxonomy overrides. Do not use this file for incident priority or execution risk.

enrol-an-iphone-or-ipad-into-mdm.reason: This is an enrolment action/request, not an observable fault.

reported-a-ransomware-alert.reason: Ransomware alert is a security incident/event requiring response handling.

a-failed-keyboard.reason: A failed keyboard is an observable endpoint/peripheral condition before root cause is known.

a-duplicate-ip-address.reason: Duplicate IP address is a diagnosed technical condition rather than an initial user observation.

support-a-vip-or-executive-user.reason: VIP/executive status is business context that changes handling and urgency, not a fault.
